verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents API tokens that can be created and expired in the dashboard, which is basic key-based access control on database operations. The permissions guide only recommends storing user/group IDs on documents and filtering at query time. That is an application-side workaround, not product-enforced authorization, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: role-based access control, per-namespace/per-collection scoped keys or permissions, read-only vs read-write key scopes, independent corroboration.
